en: The image is a black-and-white photograph depicting an industrial mining scene. There are two workers walking beside a rail track with a mining cart. The area is surrounded by wooden structures, elevated walkways, and a distinctive tower. The terrain is rugged and appears to be heavily worked. At the top of the image, there is text labeling different parts of the facility: 'Foldalen', 'Bremsebanen', 'Vaskeriet'. The bottom right contains a code: 'MINØ.2933'.
